content:
Chapter 244: Stable Source Of Qi

The nearly 400,000 Zerg troops in the Zerg territory will use the resources harvested by the Zerg troops in the public battlefield. After the upgrade is completed, they will all be sent to Mengzhong City and go through the space transmission channel of the goblin tribe to join the Zerg troops led by Wu Qing's Zerg clone in the public battlefield.

Gong Zhe received the Zerg energy coins sent by the Heavenly Silkworm Knight. Without saying a word, he immediately arranged for someone to apply for the luck beads from the tribe. He had received news from the tribe and learned about the Zerg army's impressive record in the public battlefield.

He was happy for Wu Qing and the Zerg from the bottom of his heart.

Under Gong Zhe's arrangement, the Heavenly Silkworm Knight went to the main city of the 108th District of the Public Battlefield in the Southern Theater and settled in the station given to the Zerg by the goblins.

The nearly 400,000 reinforcements of the Zerg also passed through the space transmission channel and soon arrived at the main city of the 108th District of the Public Battlefield in the Southern Theater.

They did not stop, and under the gaze of countless people, they quickly left the city and marched quickly to the east.

Countless news about the Zerg was sent back to the main city, and then spread to all directions through the main city.

The main forces in the entire southern theater learned about the performance of the Zerg army on the battlefield.

This is because the Zerg is a race that the goblins value and has received special attention. In addition, the outstanding performance of the Zerg army on the battlefield has really attracted the attention of all forces.

The goblins are of course the forces that pay the most attention to the performance of the Zerg. They are also shocked by the performance of the Zerg army. The performance of the Zerg exceeded their expectations.

When they learned that the Zerg immediately sent a large number of Zerg energy coins, the high-level officials of the goblins approved Gong Zhe's application for the luck beads on the spot. A large number of luck beads were transported to Mengzhong City through the space transmission channel and handed over to the Zerg.

The performance of the Zerg is directly related to the attitude of the goblins towards the Zerg. The goblins are not an individual, but a group, and the internal relationship is also very complicated.

…

The main city of the 108th District of the Public Battlefield in the Southern Theater.

The Zerg army joined the battle and directly wiped out the powerful army of the aliens that was rampant in this area. The news of this disappearance soon spread throughout the city.

Many races that had suffered losses at the hands of the alien army still questioned the authenticity of this news.

When all the major races tacitly agreed to the spread of this news, everyone was sure that the alien army was really wiped out by the Zerg army.

With the support of the major races, this news would not be false.

As some personnel who witnessed the Zerg army's battles on the battlefield withdrew to the main city, various details of the Zerg army were spread everywhere, and there was a trend of getting more and more outrageous.

Because the Zerg's station in the main city had already been occupied by Zerg personnel, this attracted many people in the city to inquire, and soon the Zerg station was filled with people watching the excitement.

A team of Tiancan knights rode out of the camp fully armed and hung a large sign at the entrance of the Zerg camp, writing about the inheritance of the Tiancan Nine Transformations.

Another Heavenly Silkworm Knight came out of the camp, brought tables and chairs, and set up an assessment booth at the entrance of the Zerg camp.

"Is this the Zerg? Why do they look like humans?"

"These are not Zerg! I've seen Zerg, they are all strange big bugs!"

"They should be a cavalry unit of the Zerg, the two characters of Heavenly Silkworm are so obvious!"

"Look at what is written on the sign! The inheritance of the Zerg powerhouse, Heavenly Silkworm Nine Changes! Is such a magical skill really going to be taught to the outside world?"

"Not only is the training speed extremely fast, but it can also continuously improve and enhance the training qualifications! How can such a skill be taught to the outside world?!"

"It actually has such good compatibility! What a pity! It is a parasitic cultivation method!"

"To practice the Heavenly Silkworm Nine Transformations, you need to coexist with the Heavenly Silkworm of the Zerg. This magical Heavenly Silkworm should be the core of this method!"

"This method is indeed tempting. If it turns out that this method is really as powerful as described, I can't help but switch to it!"

"What are you afraid of! We are dead, so why should we be afraid of being plotted against! ?"

"As long as we don't become zombies like the followers of the evil god, it doesn't matter if we pay a little price for strength!"

"..."

The people here are more complicated, more knowledgeable, and there are hidden dragons and crouching tigers.

As soon as the table and chairs of the Heavenly Silkworm Knight were placed, someone who had already put life and death aside walked over and sat on the chair in front of the table to participate in the assessment.

The Heavenly Silkworm Knight was very straightforward. He glanced at the person participating in the assessment, asked two questions, and handed a Heavenly Silkworm to the person participating in the assessment.

This made the person participating in the assessment and the people around him a little confused.

"That's it? Passed the test!?"

"This is too easy!"

"This is like giving it away for free! Is there any conspiracy?"

"What question did the examiner just ask? Did anyone hear it clearly?"

"It seems to be asking two questions: 'Where do you live' and 'Who do you miss the most'!"

"Is this the test? It's too much of a joke!"

"..."

The Heavenly Silkworm Knight ignored the discussion beside him and said to the person who passed the test: "The Heavenly Silkworm is not allowed to be taken away, please take it on the spot!"

The person who got the Heavenly Silkworm did not hesitate and swallowed it in one gulp. After a moment of hesitation, he stood up and made way for the seat. He walked to the side and sat cross-legged alone, and began to meditate.

Under the gaze of everyone, the person who had obtained the inheritance of the Heavenly Silkworm Nine Transformations through the Heavenly Silkworm could not help but start practicing on the spot, and his aura immediately changed significantly.

"This silkworm is really a wonder, the change is too obvious!"

"This insect thing is really not simple!"

"If this thing spreads, it may really greatly improve the strength of our ordinary people and make the source of soldiers sufficient!"

"Let's see the subsequent changes!"

"..."

It's not just ordinary people who are paying attention here, there are also many special people with extraordinary knowledge mixed in the crowd.

"'The inheritors need to support each other and not kill each other', 'Sincerity is effective', this insect race is interesting!"

A person with extraordinary momentum but not attracting attention whispered to the people around him.

The first person who got great benefits was also a smart person. He did not continue to practice, but showed his own experience, first thanked the Silkworm Knight for the inheritance, and then briefly talked about his own true feelings.

This dispelled the concerns of many people. There were many people who wanted to participate in the assessment, but they were robbed by others, so they all stopped and wanted to see the real effect.

Now that the effect has been seen, there is nothing to hesitate about.

Everyone participated in the assessment enthusiastically. Only then did the onlookers realize that not everyone could pass the assessment, and many people were eliminated.

No one knew what the assessment criteria were. After carefully analyzing the assessment questions, they could not see anything.

After the Zerg became famous throughout the city for its performance on the battlefield, it has now attracted the attention of the whole city again because of the inheritance of the Nine Changes of the Heavenly Silkworm.

Wu Qing discovered that since the Heavenly Silkworm Knight began to walk outside, the system's gas resources have been earning a lot of money every moment.

Today, the Zerg became famous on the battlefield, and the Heavenly Silkworm Knight took advantage of the publicity. The system's gas resources are growing rapidly, just like the Zerg army is fighting.

The population base of this world is particularly large. The resources that the Zerg will gain from becoming famous in the world in the future will definitely be much more than those earned from fighting, unless the Zerg launches large-scale wars on multiple battlefields at the same time and engages in crazy plunder.

Moreover, the gas resources obtained in this way are very stable and will continue, just like the Zerg worker bees mining energy resources.

With the rapid development of the Zerg, this may become the main source of system gas resources.

Wu Qing decided to save some resources, add more Silkworm Knights, and strengthen the Zerg's propaganda investment in the Southern Free Territory.

Silkworm Knights can also use their identities to find ways to go to the main cities of other areas of the public battlefield in the southern theater to promote the Zerg and spread the Silkworm Nine Transformations.

These things take time to operate, and the Queen of the Worm can be responsible for coordinating and executing them step by step.

…

On the battlefield of the battle with the alien human army, the spoils distribution plan led by the Queen of the Worm was recognized by everyone. This distribution standard has precedents to follow, is relatively simple, and there is no controversy.

When it comes to the stage of privately negotiating spoils transactions with various races, the information collected by the Queen of the Worm is not enough for the actual value of various spoils.

Wu Qing contacted Gong Yi of the Goblin tribe through the Silkworm Knights in the main city, and hired a group of merchants and appraisers from the Goblin Chamber of Commerce. Wu Qing sent a transport host to quickly send these people to the battlefield to help the Queen of the Worm conduct business negotiations with various races.

With the goblin merchants and appraisers checking, the Queen's work is easy. She can also gain a lot of relevant knowledge from it. When she encounters such things in the future, she can solve them by herself.

After a busy day, it was night. There was no strange invasion in the vast main city lord shelter area, and it could continue to work normally.

The two Zerg armies that have successfully joined forces have a strength of nearly 900,000. This is the lineup of the Zerg army that will capture the 66th city tomorrow.

To go to the 66th city, the distance is very far, and most of the marching routes are outside the lord's shelter range of the main city, so it is necessary to set off at dawn and arrive before dark. There is no problem in starting the war at night.

In this public battlefield, the lord's shelter range of each city is very large, just to allow both armies to fight around the clock.

Because the Zerg must leave here at dawn, the Queen traded spoils with various races overnight, and sold all the spoils except for information carriers.

The Zerg host explored the battlefield several times and took away what they wanted. The other things were estimated by the staff of the Goblin Chamber of Commerce, and each race made an offer according to their needs.

In this transaction, the Zerg did not even need to clean up the battlefield, but just took the money and left.

For those races that could not produce enough luck beads at once, the Zerg were not afraid of them defaulting on their debts because they had the guarantee of the Goblin race.
